name: 213 East Twentieth Street — Rowhouse, flat behind a cornice (district draft; refined by T-1939)

grade.why: Known from maps or written records; no picture of it has been found.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-2982 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 7.250, v -4.375 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -90.587 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 213 E. Twentieth Street, parcel e20th_213 (data/street_grid/1904.json), south side of East Twentieth Street, the district's named context buildings off Prairie Avenue: East Twentieth Street between Indiana and Prairie, and Calumet Avenue between 20th and 21st Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front), widened to 5.5 m along the front because the fitted strip was narrower than any house of the avenue (T-2690). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '3' printed on the 1911 sheet: 3 full storeys.

construction.note: The register reads the map's colours as 'brick'.

parts.from: s35xfp-e20th_213-b1 p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 71% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35xfp-e20th_213-b1 p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 71% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The register's red brick and sandstone rowhouse, standing today: flat behind a cornice, the roof its street front shows. The sheet's storey figure is blurred (3 or 4) and is drafted as 3, its neighbour's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2988847109 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-edges-2982.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3 brick dwelling (D) running nearly the lot's depth, its east wall stepped at the rear (the figure is blurred: 3 or 4)'. Carried to 1904 on the T-2982 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

citations.citation: Sanborn Map Company. Insurance Maps of Chicago, Illinois, Volume 3. New York: Sanborn Map Company, 1911. Sheet 35.
what_it_supplies: Footprints, lots and street widths from 20th to 22nd Street between Indiana and Calumet, as of 1911, at the copy's coarser resolution
The position of Twentieth Street, which is vacated between Indiana and Calumet today
what_it_does_not_supply: Anything as of 1904 on its own authority. It is a 1911 survey; Glessner House's reading that everything on sheets 20, 28 and 35 but 1609-1611 and 1620 Prairie stood in 1904 is attributed guidance, recorded in that README, and not checked by this record
A construction date for any building it draws
Elevations, grades, curb heights or fill depths -- no Sanborn sheet carries a level
Architecture above the footprint beyond its story count, material colour and roof symbol
Any lake edge: the sheet ends at Calumet Avenue

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2982, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1939 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35x trace (s35xfp-e20th_213-b1), the T-2982 census (s35x-213-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35x-213 (Rowhouse, flat behind a cornice); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-edges-2982).
